name: Isolda Gaillard
source: To say that Isolda is an eccentric would fall short of actually describing her. Often keeping to herself, she is almost always paying attention to something else in her peripheral vision. Yet, paradoxically, she is often fully aware of lectures and conversations around her. Her two passions are stars and birds, and she's never too far from a telescope or sketchbook to view them.
